fixed_buff: I personaggi di apertura ottengono PS max, ATT e DIF aumentati del 20%.

mechanics.season_effect_text: After the above characters join your party, Max HP, ATK, and DEF are increased by 20%.

instructions: Act 3 · Experimental Field Generator

A large and out-of-control Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering device. During combat, it channels ousia energy to unleash a Gravity Reduction Field, letting characters jump significantly higher.
Its Gravity Reduction Field shuts down when its core is annihilated by Pneuma attacks.
Act 6 · Veteran Arithmetic Enhancer Mek
During combat it channels ousia energy to unleash a Gravity Reduction Field.
Its core is defended by a Geo Ward. Destroy the Ward and annihilate the core with Pneuma attacks to shut the field down.
Act 8 · Radiant Moongecko
It can trap your characters in a Radiant Cocoon. Heal to full HP to escape it, which also lowers its Geo RES.
When it prepares Voidstep Reverberation, destroy the Moonstone Anchor it leaves behind to interrupt the skill and deal massive DMG to it.
Act 10 · Gluttonous Yumkasaur Mountain King
A battle-seasoned Yumkasaurus that grew to this size due to its gluttony. It collects Flamegranates and spits them out as bombs.
Use Pyro to ignite the Flamegranates before it can swallow them to disrupt it.
